Alex K: Quick check for INC901 postmortem action slate — can folks confirm who actually owns each item and a firm due date? goal is to close the list by end of week, so we can mark the RCA done.
Maya P: I have the runbook updates item. can do by `2026-03-22` EOD. assigning to myself.
Devon S: I can take the DB schema follow-up but need a hard dependency on infra team's ETA for the replica cutover. pinging @Zara L for that.
Zara L: infra ETA for replica cutover is Monday `2026-03-23` AM — might slip if storage perf dips. i can tentatively reserve Mon afternoon for the migration.
pm-olson: noted — product will block new canary users until the migration completes. could we get a canary verification task owner?
Alex K: @Devon S you own canary verification then? small smoke tests and perf dashboard check.
Devon S: yep will do. aiming `2026-03-23` PM (after replica). will post smoke results in this thread.
Maya P: also adding the docs + customer comms draft. @pm-olson i'll share a draft by `2026-03-21` for review.
pm-olson: thanks. i'll review quick and land comments same day.
Zara L: infra will handle the pre-migration snapshot and rollback playbook. owner: Zara L. due `2026-03-23` 10:00.
Alex K: ownership summary so far:
- Runbook updates — Maya P — `2026-03-22`
- DB schema follow-up — Devon S — `2026-03-23` (depends on infra)
- Replica cutover + snapshot — Zara L — `2026-03-23` 10:00
- Customer comms draft — pm-olson + Maya P — `2026-03-21`
- Canary verification — Devon S — `2026-03-23` PM
Can everyone confirm or update?
Devon S: quick note — need a small schema transformation script reviewed. i'll open PR and tag @Alex K for review. target PR by EOD `2026-03-20`.
Alex K: ack, i'll review first thing `2026-03-21`.
Maya P: are we missing the monitoring alert thresholds task? I can own that if no one else.
Zara L: please own it, Maya — infra will feed the new metrics to the dashboard.
Maya P: owning monitoring thresholds — due `2026-03-22` midday.
sre-bot: Reminder: INC901 action items due soon. Use `/inc actions INC901` to view live table.
Devon S: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pulls/412 — includes transform + smoke tests. @Alex K PTAL.
Alex K: reviewed + left comments, small nit. will approve after tweaks.
pm-olson: one last ask — let's ensure the postmortem doc has a clear follow-up owner list. Maya can you paste the finalized owners into the RCA doc once we close?
Maya P: yep will update RCA doc and ping infra/sre for signoff.
Alex K: ok team — last check: anybody can't meet these dates? If so call it out now. otherwise i'll mark items and start the closure checklist. :thumbsup:
Zara L: all good from infra.
Devon S: should be good barring an unexpected perf regression.
pm-olson: product aligned.
Maya P: fine on my end.
Alex K: great — i'll update the action table and set reminders. thanks everyone.
(small thread note) Alex K pinned a message: "INC901 action owners + due dates"
Devon S: posting smoke test results once migration completes.
Zara L: will post migration status in #eng-oncall during the window.
Alex K: closing thread for async confirmations; will reopen if dates shift.
